title: Switching a shape border off loses the row on the next shape
goal: Turn the border off on a box, then draw another box: the new box has no Border row at all, so getting the line back means going to the plus and adding a fresh one, at the standard width and on the outside. Every other effect behaves the opposite way: switch a shadow off, draw another shape, and the shadow row is still there, switched off, holding all its numbers, so one click brings it back exactly as it was. A border should be able to do the same.
notes:
Reproduced 2026-09-08 with two throwaway walks against the probe.

Border: draw a rectangle, press Switch in Border, draw a second rectangle, dump the panel. First box: Twist/Reorder/Switch(Border, off)/Remove/Color/Position/Slider all present. Second box: only Fill switch, Fill colour, Effects header and Add Effect. No Border row.

Shadow, same shape of test (add Shadow, switch it off, draw a second box): second box dump shows Switch | Shadow, off and Remove | Shadow. The row survives. So this is Border-only.

Cause is EditorState+LayersPanel.swift rememberable(_:shape:): annotationStyles.setStrokeWidth(edge.isOn ? edge.width : 0, forShape: shape) collapses off into width 0, and AnnotationStyles.arrivingStyle(forShape:) guards `d.strokeWidth > 0` before synthesising the border, so off means no row and the width is lost with it. Collapsing off to 0 was deliberate (the comment cites the 2026-09-06 report that a box came back outlined); the vanished row is the unchosen side effect.

One fix that needs no model change: in rememberable, when the edge is OFF leave the border effect IN the remembered style.effects instead of removing it, and still setStrokeWidth(0) so arrivingStyle does not synthesise a second one. On stays as it is today (lifted to the tool, row synthesised). Worth checking the Position memory too: Add Effect > Border makes a plain BorderEffect() (Outside), so LayerEffects.swift:490 ignores annotationStyles.strokePosition(forShape:).

NOTE this is SHARED code (EditorState+LayersPanel.swift, not under Releases/), so it changes Current as well as Next. That is why the walk-repair task on 2026-09-08 did not fix it and recorded todays behaviour instead: parts-off-is-remembered step 18 now expects NO Border row, and effects-remembered step 63 the same, both with notes pointing at this task. Those two walks must be updated when this lands.
acceptance: Turning a box border off and drawing another box leaves a Border row on the new box, switched off
The width, colour and position the border had are still on that row, so switching it back on restores the line you had rather than a standard one
A box drawn after the border was switched off still paints no line, which is the behaviour the user asked for on 2026-09-06
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/parts-off-is-remembered-walk.json and effects-remembered-walk.json both run to the end after the change, with their notes updated to claim the new behaviour
